title: UK Public Library Policy Archive — Bibliographic Metadata Schema
description: Validates canonical bibliographic metadata (metadata.yaml) for archived UK public library policy, strategy, standards, consultation, and review documents.

id.description: Unique lowercase hyphenated identifier for the archived report.

title.description: Main title transcribed verbatim from the source document.

subtitle.description: Subtitle or secondary title transcribed verbatim from the source document, or null if absent.

creators.description: List of personal authors, chairs, or corporate creators credited on the publication.

publisher.description: Publishing government department, devolved administration, public body, or sector organisation.

publication_date.description: Observable publication date in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM, or YYYY), or null if only year is known.

publication_place.description: City or place of publication as stated on the source document (e.g., London, Edinburgh, Cardiff, Belfast).

country.description: Primary UK nation or jurisdiction to which the publication applies.

language.description: ISO 639-1 / BCP 47 language code(s) of the document (e.g., 'en' or ['en', 'cy']).

document_type.description: Functional category of the policy document (e.g., policy-paper, strategy, standards, independent-review, consultation, action-plan, impact-report, guidance, research-report).

pages.description: Total page count of the preserved source document.

identifier.description: Official departmental reference, Command Paper number, or publisher publication code.

isbn.description: International Standard Book Number (ISBN-10 or ISBN-13) if printed on the document.

issn.description: International Standard Serial Number (ISSN) if issued as part of a serial.

series.description: Series or programme title to which the document belongs.

edition.description: Edition or version statement printed on the source document.

source_url.description: Canonical publication landing page URL or official web archive URL.

source_pdf.description: Relative path within the report package to the preserved PDF or direct source filename.

rights.description: Copyright and licensing statement governing the work (e.g., Crown Copyright / Open Government Licence v3.0).

review_level.description: Editorial quality assurance level of the archived package.
